{{Top|leg}}
The '''Spherical Flame''' was the sigil of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] as of the [[Dorvalla Incident]]<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].<ref name="tnec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref> [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvallan]] transports ferrying cargo to the ''[[Revenue]]'' were emblazoned with this insignia.<ref name="CoD" />
